about_the_game:
This is a demo version of "Indies 2: Burning Kindling", which contains about 11 levels of game strategy experience.

​​Indies 2: Burning Kindling​​ is a top-down 2D tactical Roguelite where you command a trio of heroes, forging legends on an ever-shifting battlefield. This fusion of ​​hardcore strategy​​ and ​​deep Roguelite progression​​ delivers a relentless cycle: ​​tactical planning → explosive power spikes → cathartic enemy annihilation​​.

As the sequel to the classic Roguelike card game Indies’ Lie, this installment continues the saga: Under the shadow of the evil god Indies, the Lady of Death awakens warriors across time. Lead your faction through procedurally generated battles and confront divine tyranny on the volatile continent of Meka!

▍Dynamic Squad Building​

Assemble a 3-member squad from ​​mechanically diverse characters​​, each with ​​exclusive Kindling abilities, equipment, relics, and battlefield roles​​. Melee charges, ranged snipes, crowd control—every team composition unlocks endless tactical possibilities.

​▍Unpredictable Roguelite Challenges​

Each expedition features ​​randomized maps, enemies, and events​​—elite ambushes, sudden disasters, cryptic altars. Unlock ​​hundreds of equipment and Kindling combos​​ to craft earth-shattering synergies. Will you focus on single-target nukes or AoE domination? The choice defines your playstyle.

​▍Tactical Chessboard Warfare​

Terrain as Weapon​​: Split enemy forces with obstacles, bait bosses into attacking their own minions.

Skill Synergy Chains​​: Qili’s ​​position-resetting combos​​, Diego’s ​​counter-trap ambushes​​, Daniel’s ​​status-spreading explosions​​—every action breeds lethal potential.

Dynamic Threat Priorities​​: Execute healers first? Interrupt charging elites? Every turn demands life-or-death decisions.

▍Freeform Build System​

Mix ​​112 tactical components​​: 12 hero-exclusive relics × 9 game-breaking equipment × 7 high-risk Burning Kindling effects. Craft builds like ​​Blink Crit​​, ​​Counter Tank​​, or ​​Toxin Overload​​—your creativity is the ultimate weapon.
